concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-customer-create-node]] - Node.js customer creation alone or with payment-method and billing-address variants, optional case-insensitive merchant customer IDs, validation and card-verification qualifications, Control Panel-configured custom fields, and retained collected-document gaps
warnings: Preserve the payment-method success conditions and the distinction between default card validation and separately requested verification; do not turn recommendations into requirements.
Keep the Premium Fraud Management Tools device_data language conditional and advisory: the page strongly recommends it when those tools are in use and a card is verified.
Do not reconstruct the missing action or option names in the malformed lines 20-21 transaction note, and do not invent a blank-customer invocation absent from lines 72-75.
Do not generalize this Node.js guide to other SDK languages or treat linked validation, transaction, or Control Panel pages as fully read evidence.
